SELECT d.DELIVERY_ID, d.DELIVERY_STATUS, d.TRACKING_NO, d.CARRIER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(d.SHIPPED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS SHIPPED_AT, DATE_FORMAT(d.DELIVERED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS DELIVERED_AT, DATE_FORMAT(d.PICKED_UP_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS PICKED_UP_AT, d.RECEIVER_NAME, d.ADDRESS, d.ORDER_ID,
o.ORDER_TYPE, o.ORDER_STATUS, DATE_FORMAT(o.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS CREATED_AT, o.USER_ID, o.GUEST_NAME, o.GUEST_PHONE FROM delivery d INNER JOIN orders o ON d.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID WHERE d.DELIVERY_ID = #{deliveryId} AND o.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT oi.ITEM_ID AS itemId, oi.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.PRODUCT_TYPE AS productType, oi.QUANTITY AS quantity, oi.UNIT_PRICE AS unitPrice, DATE_FORMAT(oi.START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(oi.END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate,
pi.IMG_URL AS imgUrl, b.BRAND_NAME AS brandName, c.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN product p ON oi.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON p.PRODUCT_ID = pi.PRODUCT_ID AND pi.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.BRAND_ID = b.BRAND_ID LEFT JOIN product_category c ON p.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID WHERE oi.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.ITEM_ID ASC

SELECT d.DELIVERY_ID, COALESCE(d.DELIVERY_STATUS, 'PREPARING') AS DELIVERY_STATUS, d.TRACKING_NO, d.CARRIER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(d.SHIPPED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS SHIPPED_AT, DATE_FORMAT(d.DELIVERED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS DELIVERED_AT, DATE_FORMAT(d.PICKED_UP_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS PICKED_UP_AT, d.RECEIVER_NAME, d.ZIPCODE, d.ADDRESS, d.DETAILED_ADDRESS,
o.ORDER_ID, o.ORDER_TYPE, o.ORDER_STATUS, DATE_FORMAT(o.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS CREATED_AT, o.USER_ID, o.GUEST_NAME, o.GUEST_PHONE FROM orders o LEFT JOIN delivery d ON o.ORDER_ID = d.ORDER_ID WHERE o.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND ( o.USER_ID = #{userId} OR o.USER_ID IS NULL )
